fields.title: noon.com record
fields.description: One row per product, product detail, seller offer, category node, facet, noon Minutes product, or error. The record type is in `recordType`. noon's own catalogue JSON is passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here can and do appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (keyword, category path, brand code, SKU or URL) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record: S1-mp-catalog (main marketplace), S1-instant-catalog (noon Minutes), or none for error rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records -- the error kind (not_found, blocked, bad_input, no_offers, empty_payload, no_results, run_failed).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PRODUCT, PRODUCT_DETAIL, OFFER, CATEGORY, FACET, INSTANT_PRODUCT or ERROR.

country.title: Country
country.description: The noon storefront this record came from (ae, sa, eg, kw, qa, bh, om).

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The x-locale value used, for example en-ae.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for every price on this record, derived from the country. noon's API returns bare numbers with no currency field of its own.

page.title: Page
page.description: Which result page this product came from.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: The public noon.com page for this product, rebuilt from the slug, SKU and locale.

catalog_sku.title: Catalog SKU
catalog_sku.description: Catalogue-level SKU including the variant suffix.

name.title: Name
name.description: Product title as shown in listings.

product_title.title: Product title
product_title.description: Product title as shown on the product page.

brand_code.title: Brand code
brand_code.description: Brand's lowercase code, usable as the Brand mode input.

price.title: Price
price.description: List price in the record's currency.

sale_price.title: Sale price
sale_price.description: Discounted price when one is running, otherwise null.

product_rating.title: Rating
product_rating.description: Aggregate rating object with `value` and `count`. Individual review text is not available through this API.

rating.title: Rating (detail mode)
rating.description: Same aggregate rating, on PRODUCT_DETAIL rows.

is_buyable.title: Buyable
is_buyable.description: Whether the offer can currently be bought.

is_bestseller.title: Best seller
is_bestseller.description: Whether noon flags this as a best seller.

best_seller_rank.title: Best seller rank
best_seller_rank.description: Rank within its category when noon publishes one.

partner_code.title: Partner code
partner_code.description: noon's internal code for the seller.

partner_ratings_sellerlab.title: Partner ratings (SellerLab)
partner_ratings_sellerlab.description: Seller rating summary from noon's SellerLab programme.

seller_ratings.title: Seller ratings
seller_ratings.description: Seller rating detail on an offer.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Units the seller currently has available.

stock_minimum_quantity.title: Minimum quantity
stock_minimum_quantity.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered.

image_key.title: Image key
image_key.description: noon CDN key for the primary image.

image_keys.title: Image keys
image_keys.description: noon CDN keys for all images.

url.title: Slug
url.description: The product's URL slug (not a full URL).

pdp_url.title: PDP path
pdp_url.description: Product page path as noon returns it.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Fulfilment and eligibility flags, for example fbn or free_delivery_eligible.

deal_tag.title: Deal tag
deal_tag.description: Deal badge attached to the offer.

discount_tag_title.title: Discount title
discount_tag_title.description: Headline text of a running discount.

discount_tag_detail.title: Discount detail
discount_tag_detail.description: Detail text of a running discount.

discount_tag_terms.title: Discount terms
discount_tag_terms.description: Terms attached to a running discount.

discount_tag_code.title: Discount code
discount_tag_code.description: noon's code for the running discount.

discount_canonical_url.title: Discount URL
discount_canonical_url.description: Path to the discount's landing page.

nudges.title: Nudges
nudges.description: Urgency and promotional nudges noon shows on the tile.

plp_specifications.title: Listing specs
plp_specifications.description: Key specifications noon surfaces on the listing tile.

specifications.title: Specifications
specifications.description: Full specification list, on product-detail rows.

feature_bullets.title: Feature bullets
feature_bullets.description: Bullet-point feature list from the product page.

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: Category path from noon's home down to this product.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Other variants of this product, each carrying its own seller offers.

media_gallery.title: Media gallery
media_gallery.description: Images and video for the product page.

fbt_offers.title: Frequently bought together
fbt_offers.description: Products noon pairs with this one.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Merchandising groups the product belongs to.

offerRank.title: Offer rank
offerRank.description: Position of this seller offer in noon's own ordering; rank 1 is the offer shown by default.

offerCount.title: Offer count
offerCount.description: How many sellers were listed for this product.

lowestOfferPrice.title: Lowest offer
lowestOfferPrice.description: Cheapest seller price found for this product.

highestOfferPrice.title: Highest offer
highestOfferPrice.description: Most expensive seller price found for this product.

offer_code.title: Offer code
offer_code.description: noon's identifier for a specific seller offer.

product_sku.title: Product SKU
product_sku.description: SKU of the product this offer belongs to, on OFFER rows.

variant_sku.title: Variant SKU
variant_sku.description: SKU of the variant this offer belongs to.

estimated_delivery.title: Delivery estimate
estimated_delivery.description: Delivery promise text for this offer.

estimated_delivery_date.title: Delivery date
estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date for this offer.

is_returnable.title: Returnable
is_returnable.description: Whether this offer can be returned.

return_policy.title: Return policy
return_policy.description: Return policy attached to the offer.

id_category.title: Category ID
id_category.description: noon's numeric category ID, on CATEGORY rows.

id_category_parent.title: Parent category ID
id_category_parent.description: Numeric ID of the parent category.

code.title: Code
code.description: Slash-joined category code, or the facet's code on FACET rows.

parent_code.title: Parent code
parent_code.description: Category code of the parent node.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How deep this category sits in the tree; 0 is a root.

child_count.title: Child count
child_count.description: How many direct children this category has.

sort_key.title: Sort key
sort_key.description: noon's own ordering weight for the category.

facetGroup.title: Facet group
facetGroup.description: Whether the facet came from `facets` or `dynamicFacets`.

type.title: Type
type.description: Facet type, for example brand, bool or category.

optionCount.title: Option count
optionCount.description: How many options this facet offers.

options.title: Options
options.description: The facet's options, with counts where noon publishes them.

target.title: Facet target
target.description: Whether the facets were read from a search or a category.

nbHits.title: Result count
nbHits.description: noon's own result count. This is an approximate, sharded figure that drifts between identical calls -- treat it as a hint, not a total.

nbPages.title: Page count
nbPages.description: noon's own page count, approximate for the same reason as nbHits.

canonical_url.title: Canonical URL
canonical_url.description: The query noon says it actually ran, after dropping any parameters it ignored.

listing_nbHits.title: Listing result count
listing_nbHits.description: nbHits of the listing page this product came from.

listing_nbPages.title: Listing page count
listing_nbPages.description: nbPages of the listing page this product came from.

listing_canonical_url.title: Listing canonical URL
listing_canonical_url.description: The query noon actually ran for this listing page.

listing_viewType.title: View type
listing_viewType.description: Layout noon intended for this listing.

whCode.title: Warehouse code
whCode.description: Which noon Minutes dark store answered, on INSTANT_PRODUCT rows.

childItemsDetails.title: Child items
childItemsDetails.description: Items inside a noon Minutes bundle, with size, weight and volume.

title.title: Title
title.description: Product title on noon Minutes rows (Minutes uses `title` where the marketplace uses `name`).

salePrice.title: Sale price (Minutes)
salePrice.description: Discounted price on noon Minutes rows. Minutes returns every field twice, in camelCase and snake_case; both are passed through unchanged.

offerPrice.title: Offer price (Minutes)
offerPrice.description: Price actually charged on noon Minutes rows.

strikedPrice.title: Struck-through price
strikedPrice.description: The crossed-out reference price on noon Minutes rows.

discountPercent.title: Discount %
discountPercent.description: Discount percentage on noon Minutes rows.

sizeInfo.title: Size
sizeInfo.description: Pack size as shown on noon Minutes, for example 2L or 30g.

maxQty.title: Max quantity
maxQty.description: Largest quantity orderable on noon Minutes.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Item weight used by noon Minutes for basket limits.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Item volume used by noon Minutes for basket limits.

isBuyable.title: Buyable (Minutes)
isBuyable.description: Whether the noon Minutes item can currently be bought.

media.title: Media
media.description: Images for a noon Minutes item.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Present on run-level error rows: which mode was running when it failed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across product, offer, category, facet and error records.

minutes.title: noon Minutes
minutes.description: Grocery items from the 15-minute delivery catalogue.

offers.title: Seller offers
offers.description: One row per seller competing on a product.
